title: New Placements and Military Service Hold Review Proof Requests
content:
**Placements desk table — Hardship and Protective Holds.** When current proof of active military duty is asked for before a status review of a running Military Service Hold, the new-placement allowance of the status review proof depends on the servicemember's accounts placed with Ridgeline less than two whole months before today, as shown by the placement entries in the servicemember's Placed Consumer Accounts money history. Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the placement date and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the date's day of the month. The allowance is added once to the days allowed for the status review proof.

| Accounts placed in that period | New-placement allowance |
|---|---|
| At least the placements-many count of 2 | 7 calendar days (many-placement proof days) |
| Exactly 1 | 4 calendar days (one-placement proof days) |
| None | Nothing |

**Reading.** Every account of the servicemember placed in the period counts, not only the held account. A placement dated exactly two whole months before today is not inside the period.

**Example (hypothetical).** Today is 10 June. One account was placed on 10 April (2 whole months — outside) and one on 20 May (inside): one placement, 4 calendar days are added.
